data.body_html:
Watching the Marbella New Year's Eve fireworks from a private boat is the smartest way to see the show without the crowds. As midnight strikes, the sky over Puerto Banús and Marbella Marina erupts in colour, and from the water you get a front-row seat that no beach or promenade can match. This guide covers the best anchor spots, which boats to book, and what it costs for NYE 2047.

Why Watch NYE Fireworks from a Boat?

The Marbella fireworks display is spectacular, but on land you're fighting for space along the Golden Mile and the Puerto Banús promenade. From a boat, you avoid the crush, have your own bar, and can toast the New Year with cava in hand. You'll see the fireworks reflected in the water, with the illuminated coastline from Marbella to Estepona as a backdrop. It's a private, comfortable, and unforgettable way to celebrate.

Best Anchor Spots for the Fireworks

Our skippers know the prime positions. For NYE 2047, the best anchorages are:

  • Off Puerto Banús – directly in front of the marina entrance, with a clear view of the main launch site.
  • Río Verde inlet – a sheltered spot just east of the port, still close to the action.
  • Cala del Faro – a little further out, but with a panoramic view of both Puerto Banús and Marbella Marina.
  • Cabopino – for a quieter, more distant view, if you prefer to avoid the crowds.

Your skipper will monitor the wind and tide to keep you stable and safe. Anchorages are allocated on a first-come, first-served basis, so departing early (around 10 PM) is wise.

What's Included in Your NYE Charter

Every boat includes a licensed skipper who handles navigation and anchoring. You'll have unlimited water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, and cava – perfect for a midnight toast. Light snacks are provided, but you're welcome to bring your own food. The boat is insured and fully equipped with safety gear. The 21% Spanish IVA is always included in the price, so there are no hidden costs.

How to Make Your NYE Evening Special

Bring warm clothes – December evenings on the water are cool (10-15°C). Decorate your boat with fairy lights or a small tree. Many guests bring a playlist; most boats have Bluetooth speakers. If you're on the Mangusta 80, you can even use the included jet ski for a spin before the fireworks (with skipper's permission). Remember to book a table at a Puerto Banús restaurant for after the show, or simply enjoy the view from the boat.
